correctness.rationale: The number operator N commutes with H, and q^N/(1+q)^3 is faithful and stationary: its center populations obey γ₋q=γ₊. End swap commutes with all parts of the generator, so sector projection yields two normalized stationary states with center marginal τ₂ and end weights 1:q:q² in the triplet and pure singlet in the other sector. For any imaginary-axis adjoint eigenoperator, the stationary trace of the dissipative commutator identity is zero. Faithfulness and positivity of each rate force commutation with both center ladders, hence identity on site 2. The independent center ladder terms in [H,X] then force the end part to commute with both collective ladders (J≠0). The ladders connect |00⟩, |T⟩, |11⟩ with nonzero coefficients, and their common kernel is exactly the singlet; using their commutator also separates the end-excitation weights. The resulting two-dimensional commutant is spanned by the sector projectors, both fixed. Uniform boundedness excludes imaginary-axis Jordan blocks, so the arbitrary-state limit follows with the two conserved sector weights. As a separate check of concurrence, the spin flip exchanges |00⟩ and |11⟩ and preserves the singlet/triplet projectors. The square-root eigenvalues entering Wootters are therefore w,b,b,b with b=(1−w)q/(1+q+q²), giving max(0,w−3b) even when w<b. For |100⟩, w=1/2, so concurrence is positive exactly when positive q differs from 1, and at q=e^(-βω) approaching 1 it is (βω)²/6 to leading order. Equality at the threshold gives zero.
residual_risks: Both jumps strictly positive, mirror-symmetric nonzero hopping, three sites and strictly local center dissipators. No claim at zero pump, asymmetry, or with energy-resolved global dissipators.

value.rationale: The smallest chain with a dissipative center and two ends already distinguishes loss of noiseless vectors from the persistence of mixed-state memory. The quantitative threshold predicts whether the surviving memory is actually entangled, not merely whether multiple fixed points exist. It also settles the sign and near-balanced-rate scale of entanglement generated from a concrete product state. These predictions are not supplied by the existence bound from symmetry alone.
residual_risks: No broader chain-length, convergence-rate, robustness or thermalization theorem claimed.
